messages:
oncall-bot: PAGER — kv-cache fragmentation spike detected in prod-dedicated-3 pool (high OOM rate). alert_id=INC-1975001234. Auto-scaling blocked, multiple requests failing with 503s. Escalation level: page oncall.
Alex R: I'm paged, joining. Any impacted customer list yet?
Maya S: seeing repeated cuda OOMs on /workers/{ded-3}-* starting ~00:07 UTC. Heap shows high total GPU reserved despite low active tokens -> fragmentation.
Eli G: logs show PyTorch allocator warnings: \"CUDA failed to allocate 0.5 GiB (out of memory)\" interleaved with many small free/alloc patterns. Suspect continuous batching change yesterday.
Samir P: confirmed a rollout yesterday of cont_batching_v2 -> increased batch_window_ms from 12 -> 50ms. That raised average batch sizes and KV churn.
Alex R: immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable continuous batching at edge for prod-dedicated-3 2) roll back batch_window_ms to 10ms 3) trigger per-process arena compaction / env tweak 4) recycle a subset of workers gradually.
Maya S: I'll flip flag in rollout manager now. Doing canary -> 10% of nodes.
Maya S: PATCH (internal):
```
POST https://infra.internal/api/rollouts/flags
{
  "flag": "cont_batching_enabled",
  "value": false,
  "scope": "prod-dedicated-3",
  "notes": "emergency rollback kv-frag ongoing incident INC-1975001234"
}
```
Alex R: Samir, while that's rolling, can you apply PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF to reduce fragmentation on nodes that are already hot? Suggest: max_split_size_mb:64
Samir P: applying to canary nodes now via config agent:
```
env.PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF = "max_split_size_mb:64"
systemctl restart redwood-runtime
```
Samir P: also enabling async free hint: CUDA_MALLOC_ASYNC=1 on newer drivers, but only if driver >= 11.8. I'll skip if not compatible.
infra-bot: rolling update started on 6 nodes in prod-dedicated-3 (canary). 2/6 updated.
Alex R: curl hit to debug endpoint to force KV compaction on affected process:
```
for n in $(hostlist canary); do
  curl -sS http://$n:8080/debug/kv/compact -X POST || echo "failed $n";
done
```
Maya S: compaction responses look good for 2 nodes -> free memory jumped ~600MiB reported in /metrics
Customer Success: any user-facing impact? Do we need a status page update?
Eli G: yes — ongoing 503s for requests routed to ded-3 started ~00:06 UTC. Preliminary count: ~1.4k failed requests in last 12min. Affected customers: ["acme-inc", "beta-saas", "finlytics", "eduverse", "lowlatency start"], mostly Dedicated customers on prod-dedicated-3.
Alex R: SLAs: we may be breaching p99 latency for those tenants; recommend a short status update: we are investigating memory regressions affecting a subset of Dedicated hosts; mitigation in progress.
Samir P: after env tweak & compaction, saw allocator log lines:
```
[2026-03-15T00:12:23Z] PyTorchAllocator: warning: detected fragmentation pattern. Suggested PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF max_split_size_mb
[2026-03-15T00:12:24Z] RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 512 MiB (GPU 0; 31.75 GiB total capacity; 29.4 GiB already reserved by PyTorch)
```
Alex R: good catch. Next step: increase recycle window for workers serving large KV sets -> rotate 20% nodes every 3m to bleed fragmentation before full roll.
Maya S: can do. Starting rotation: marking nodes for drain -> recycle.
Eli G: handoff plan: I'll stay on until we see stable metrics for 30m. If anything spikes, page me (@Eli G). After that, hand to overnight oncall Eli.
Samir P: long-term follow-ups for postmortem: 1) revert cont_batching_v2 default window; 2) add automated KV arena compaction when fragmentation pattern detected; 3) better canary metric (fragmentation ratio); 4) test PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF permutations in perf lab.
Alex R: agreed. Add runbook item: if fragmentation threshold >0.4 and OOM rate >5/min -> disable cont batching and apply alloc conf and compact.
Customer Success: we'll draft a short customer note once you confirm degraded hosts list. Include ETA for full fix (recycle + config) => ~40-60 minutes.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-1975001234 status updated: mitigations deployed (cont_batching disabled canary -> staged), allocator env tweak applied to 10% nodes, compaction triggered. Next update in 10m or on status change.
Alex R: metrics update: after 18m, error rate dropped ~78% on canary pathway, memory reclaimed on updated nodes. Still watching ded-3 remainder.
Eli G: taking primary follow-up. Handing off to @Eli G for next 2h. Ping oncall if error rate >10% again.
Maya S: continuing rollout to remaining nodes gradually with health checks (wait 2m between batches). I'll post when complete.
Samir P: capturing logs and attaching to the incident ticket for postmortem. Also creating a short eval to reproduce fragmentation with cont_batching load pattern in perf lab.
Alex R: thanks team. After stable, we should schedule a canary-only A/B to validate cont_batching_v2 with tuned max_split_size_mb before re-enable.
Customer Success: noted. I'll prepare a customer-facing timeline and send initial blurb now.
